input.quote: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party irrevocably submits to personal jurisdiction and waives any objection based on venue or inconvenient forum.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects the laws of the State of New York and 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County — exactly our preferred position on both law and forum. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document (a search for "arbitration" returns no results), so there is no foreign-seat arbitration risk. The pre-filing executive escalation step in 28.3 and the carve-out permitting interim injunctive relief in another court do not displace New York courts and expressly do not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings; noted for information only. No redline required.
